responsibility: Defines the main target macros for the Nios II port, describing architectural properties and ABI-visible conventions rather than executable logic. It specifies endianness defaults, data layout, register numbering and fixed/call-used sets, allocation order, assembler and linker defaults, section directives, exception-handling encodings, small-data thresholds, preprocessor builtins, and numerous target macros that shape how the generic GCC middle end views Nios II registers, memory model, and object-file conventions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike nios2.cc's procedural backend code, nios2.md's RTL pattern definitions, and nios2.opt's option declarations, this header is the declarative target-macro interface for the port, fixing ABI-visible constants, register/layout definitions, specs, and assembler/object-format conventions seen by generic GCC code.
